author: CrashCourse
description:
From Krakatoa to Pompeii to Mount Saint Helens, volcanoes can do some major damage. But they’re not just killing machines! In this video we’ll explore one of geology’s hottest creations — how they work, where they come from, and just how dangerous they really are.

Introduction: Lake Taupo 00:00
What is a volcano? 1:11
How volcanoes form 3:07
Yellowstone Volcano 5:42
Risk of Eruptions 8:01
Review & Credits 9:57
